# Agora API guide

Agora is a hosted payment workflow preview with an isolated Stripe TEST-mode API. Test cards do not move money. Live charges and payouts are disabled. The Vercel preview points to a separate QA Worker and Durable Object; do not treat its records as production accounting data.

- REST base: https://agora-payments.vercel.app/api/v1
- API reference: https://agora-payments.vercel.app/api-reference
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://agora-payments.vercel.app/openapi.json
- CLI installer (private prerelease; requires `gh auth login` and repository access): `(set -o pipefail; gh api repos/pkyanam/agora-cli/contents/install.sh -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json' | bash)`
- CLI source: https://github.com/pkyanam/agora-cli
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer $AGORA_API_KEY`; keys are scoped to one merchant and one provider mode.
- Never place API keys in browser code. Treat the key as a secret and revoke it if exposed.
- All amounts are integer USD cents (`4900` means $49.00).
- Every POST mutation requires an `Idempotency-Key`; retry with the same key and exact JSON payload. Changed payload under the same key returns 409.
- Product: `GET /products`, `POST /products` (`products:read`, `products:write`).
- Payment: `GET /payments`, `GET /payments/{id}`, `POST /payments` (`payments:read`, `payments:write`). Checkout creation returns an absolute Agora checkout wrapper URL. The hosted QA environment uses Stripe-hosted test Checkout; confirmation follows a verified signed provider event.
- Reconcile: `POST /payments/{id}/reconcile` (`payments:write`). It retrieves only the stored session for this tenant and validates provider mode and metadata.
- Refund: `POST /refunds` with `payment_id`, `amount`, and `reason` (`refunds:write`). Refunds remain pending until Stripe confirms them; an approved agent request is not an executed refund.
- Events: `GET /events?cursor=0&limit=25` (`events:read`); follow `next_cursor`.
- API keys are pinned to sandbox, test, or live mode when created. A key cannot switch modes when global configuration changes.
- New merchant registration requires review. Every merchant must connect its own provider account; the founder's account is never shared across tenants.
- Stripe test-mode events and fake cards are for integration testing only. Do not use real cards, bank credentials, or live API keys in the hosted preview.
- The standalone CLI accepts `AGORA_URL` and `AGORA_API_KEY`, emits JSON, and stores no credentials. Run `agora --help` for commands.
